summary: End-to-end Sales/POS module testing. Backend: 23/28 pytest cases passed (82%). Frontend UI smoke test: 100% — all 4 tabs render, sidebar shows 'Ventas', Servicios CRUD reflects backend data (TEST_Consulta_Upd Q250 / TEST_Limpieza Q350.50), Sesiones de caja shows TEST_Caja_Principal + closed session with opening Q500 / esperado Q780 / real Q785 / diferencia Q5 (correctly computed), Ventas del día shows summary cards + 3 rows (Cliente Cash V-...-0001 Q280 Efectivo Pagada, Cliente Parcial V-...-0002 Q392.56 Anulada, V-...-0003 Q560 Pagada), POS empty state shown after session close. TWO CRITICAL backend bugs found.

critical.issue: When any payment uses payment_method='card' the request returns 500 with Postgres error: "invalid input value for enum payment_method: 'card'" (code 22P02). The Postgres `payment_method` enum does NOT include 'card', but the frontend (SalesPage.js line 26 PAY_LABEL, line 456 default 'card', line 498 SelectItem value='card') and backend default ('cash') and PDF (line 4431) all use 'card'. Effect: any sale paid with Tarjeta is rejected. WORSE: the sale row + sale_items + inventory_movements are inserted BEFORE payments (no transaction), so a failed payment insert leaves an orphan sale row that already has payment_status computed from the requested payments list and therefore appears as 'paid' in Ventas del día with no actual payment row (visible in screenshot: V-20260425-0003 Q560 'Pagada' but Pago column shows '—'). Data integrity bug in addition to the enum mismatch.

PDF generation always fails. Backend log: 'Generate sale PDF error: column clinics.nit does not exist (code 42703)'. server.py:4337 selects clinics.nit which is not in the schema. Result: pdf_url is empty after a sale, the recibo PDF is never uploaded to Supabase storage, /pdf-url returns {url: ''}, the 'Imprimir' UX action will be broken.

minor.issue: Sale creation is not transactional. Sale → items → inventory_movements → payments → AR → PDF run sequentially with try/except wrappers; any failure leaves partial data. Recommend wrapping in a Postgres RPC/transaction or at least rolling back the sale row if payments fail.
N+1 query pattern: per sale fetches cashier, branch, items, payments separately (4 extra queries × N sales). Will be slow once volume grows. Recommend batched joins or RPC.

integration_issues.issue: The Tarjeta button in ChargeModal will trigger a 500 response from /api/clinic/sales because of the payment_method enum mismatch. User cannot register card payments at all (single or mixed).
Clicking Imprimir on a sale opens an empty signed URL because PDF generation fails (clinics.nit). Receipt PDF never produced.

issues: Ventas del día filter uses native HTML date input (browser default) instead of shadcn Calendar component — inconsistent with the rest of the app. Recommend switching to <Calendar /> popover.

No data-testid attributes on key elements (tabs, Nuevo servicio, Nueva caja, Abrir caja, Cobrar, Anular, payment-method buttons, sale-row, charge-modal submit). Hard to write reliable Playwright tests.

Backend: cash registers POST/GET (validation + branch_name enrichment)

Frontend: Servicios tab shows 2 services with price/duración/estado columns

action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): payment_method enum mismatch. Either (a) add 'card' to the Postgres enum payment_method via a migration, or (b) standardize on the existing enum values (likely 'credit_card'/'debit_card' or similar — check the DB) and update frontend SalesPage.js (PAY_LABEL, addPay default, SelectItem value, SummaryCard label) + backend defaults + PDF method_label dict. Inspect schema: `SELECT unnest(enum_range(NULL::payment_method));` to know the canonical values.

FIX (CRITICAL): generate_sale_pdf selects clinics.nit which does not exist. Either add nit column to clinics table, or change the SELECT in server.py:4337 to use only existing columns (and gracefully degrade NIT to empty string or fetch from clinic_settings if that's where it lives).

FIX (HIGH): wrap create_sale in a transaction (Supabase RPC or function) so a payment insert failure rolls back the sale + sale_items + inventory_movements. Otherwise orphan 'paid' sales with no payment row appear in Ventas del día (already happened during testing — V-20260425-0003 visible in screenshot).

RECOMMEND: Add data-testid to SalesPage interactive elements (tabs, Nuevo servicio, Nueva caja, Abrir caja, service-card-{id}, cart-row, Cobrar, payment-method buttons, charge-submit, sale-row-{id}, Anular, Imprimir).
RECOMMEND: Replace native date input on Ventas del día filter with shadcn Calendar.
RECOMMEND: server.py is now 4478 lines — split sales/POS routes into /app/backend/routers/sales.py.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 4400 lines — must be split into routers (sales, cash-session, inventory, agenda, etc.).
create_sale is not transactional. Multi-step inserts (sale → items → movements → payments → AR → PDF) can leave partial data on any failure. The 'card' enum error already produced an orphan sale.
Frontend/backend enum drift: 'card' is hard-coded in 4+ places in SalesPage.js but rejected by the DB enum. There is no validation layer (Pydantic) catching this mismatch — relies on Postgres error.
PDF generator silently swallows errors via try/except → return None. The caller stores empty pdf_url and the user sees an empty signed URL. Should at minimum log loudly and surface a 503/warning.
list_sales does N+1 queries (per sale: cashier, branch, items, payments). Will degrade quickly. Consider Postgres views or RPCs.
_generate_sale_number is racy — two concurrent sales same second can collide on the seq. Use a sequence or unique constraint + retry.

success_rate.backend: 82.1% (23/28 passed). 5 failures all stem from the 2 critical bugs above (3 cascade from card-enum, 1 from PDF, 1 daily-summary cascade).
success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (sidebar+route+4 tabs+empty state+real data render). Charge-with-card and Imprimir flows not exercised due to known backend bugs.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (card enum): Postgres enum payment_method defined in Supabase migration does not include literal 'card'. Likely uses {'cash','credit_card','debit_card','transfer','credit'} or similar. Frontend & backend both assume 'card'. Reproduction: POST /api/clinic/sales with payments=[{payment_method:'card', amount:N}] → 500 "invalid input value for enum payment_method: 'card'". Bug 2 (PDF): server.py:4337 `sdb.table('clinics').select('name,address,city,phone,email,nit')` — column 'nit' missing in clinics table (likely lives in clinic_settings or never migrated). Reproduction: any successful sale → background generate_sale_pdf logs 'column clinics.nit does not exist' → returns None → /pdf-url returns empty url. Mitigation: pick canonical enum values + DB migration + update both ends; fix the SELECT to omit nit or fetch it from the right table.
